body:
_Migrated from issue #882, filed 2026-07-13._

**Requested by** @iroQuai in #699 (part of the highlights follow-ups).

## What
On a book's page in the new UI, the **Highlights** button opens the per-book annotations view but gives no signal about whether the book actually has any saved highlights. Add a small count badge next to the button so a book with highlights stands out at a glance.

## Where
- Button: `frontend/src/pages/BookDetail.tsx:418` (`<Link href={/book/${book.id}/annotations}>` with the `Highlighter` icon).
- Data source already exists: `GET /annotations/<book_id>/data.json` returns `{"annotations": [...], "annotation_count": N}` (`cps/annotations.py:512`). Preferred: surface `annotation_count` on the book-detail serializer (`cps/api/serializers.py`) so BookDetail renders the badge from its existing book fetch without a second request; the data.json count stays the source of truth.

## Modality / a11y
- The badge is a count, not an action — render it inside the existing button so touch/mouse/keyboard hit targets are unchanged.
- Zero count → no badge (don't add visual noise to books with no highlights).
- Accessible name should read e.g. "Highlights, 12 saved" so it isn't a bare number to a screen reader.

Design + verify matrix: `notes/699-koreader-highlights-DESIGN.md`.

Part of #699.
title: New UI: show highlight count badge on the Highlights button
